The gallery only appeared when `isEditableSurface` in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts` was true, and that selector required `editMode`. I removed that requirement. The other conditions still apply. Embedded, shared and dashboard views still get the plain `ChartFilter` dropdown. So does any insight the user can't edit, since `canEditInsight` and `editingDisabledReason` still gate it. The feature flag and the trends-only check are unchanged.

I didn't add a test. The existing `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` renders with `editMode`, so it still passes as written. A view-mode case would be a natural addition.
